auditor.actual_model_source: harness session model (system prompt: Model: radient/auto); no fallback used
auditor.independence_basis: Separate session from both translators (canvas translator session f21dffa6aee9; surfaces translator session 352ac9921511, per their receipts). This auditor read the catalogue bytes and did not author or edit any value.

scope: All values translated by the batch (keys present at the translation commit and absent from its parent) in the touched es namespaces, read against the English source and the en context sidecars at the audited head. Pre-existing values were machine-scanned for the same terminology and identical-value checks but not re-audited semantically. No rendered-frame pass and no native-speaker sign-off are claimed.
method: Read 100% of the batch values in the es catalogue against en and en.context.json.
Parsed ICU arguments, plural and select arms; compared every placeholder, number/date skeleton, markup token, backtick and whitespace byte.
Checked Spanish CLDR categories one/many/other; 'few' absent; every plural arm uses the locale's categories.
Checked NFC, manual bidi controls, NBSP/NNBSP/ZWSP/BOM/SHY, duplicate keys.
Scanned whole touched namespaces for glossary/terminology drift, register and identical values.

findings.current: La sesión caducó; ejecuta ... / Uso no disponible; último valor conocido ... / Cambió en el disco; cárgalo ... / Ya está actualizado; el archivo no ha cambiado.
findings.proposed: Use ' — ' where the English uses an em dash, unless the semicolon is a recorded locale call.
findings.reason: The es style guide says em dash ' — ' with spaces; the translator systematically substitutes a semicolon in status/error copy. Grammatical, but a style deviation.

findings.current: Vista de Canvas / Cerrar Canvas (capital C mid-sentence)
findings.proposed: Vista de canvas / Cerrar canvas (or record 'Canvas' as the product name and apply it everywhere).
findings.reason: Glossary consistency: the pre-existing catalogue uses lowercase mid-sentence ('Abrir canvas', 'Cerrar canvas' in ui.command_palette and ui.shell.rail), the English source is lowercase, and the surfaces shortcuts keys use lowercase; this batch introduces 'Canvas' in two keys.

findings.proposed: Add a Spanish 'many' arm that reuses {plurallabel}: many {de {plurallabel}}.
findings.reason: Spanish CLDR selects 'many' at exact million multiples; with no many arm the pager would render '1.000.000 sesiones' instead of '1.000.000 de sesiones'. The English message carries only label/plurallabel, so the many arm can reuse plurallabel without a new placeholder.

Overflow findings are source-length inspections; the sidecars carry no maxCells/maxChars for these keys, so a rendered check is still required.
